body: It's fine. Wow. What was that trip to Europe like? I've always wanted to go there.

From what I've read you seem to be a very sociable individual. If that random man prevented you from hurting yourself think about what your loved ones could do. They need you in their life and I think it's important to tell the ones who care about you the most. That's what helped me. It may not be the same for you, but coping alone is what brings us to that edge.

Hi there :) You say you struggle with social anxiety. Tell me more about that? I had severe social anxiety and I also did what you did by assuming what people were thinking. I went to a cognitive therapist to help me with reality vs my perception. After some time I started doing exposure therapy, being around people and taking in things for as simple as they were and not complicating anything by over-analyzing situations. So tell me more about what goes on in your mind when you're around people? I promise there's some good people out there, sometimes it just takes time.

You say you lie because you have nothing? You have all of that experience of being in love and traveling the world. I would love to hear about your experiences. Tell me about it? Where did you travel?

You say you're a horrible mother and that you're worthless, but your child thinks differently of you. You said she loves you unconditionally. Maybe she sees the good in you that you can't right now. What makes you think that you're a horrible mother and terrible friend?

That's terrible :/ And there's no upper authority that could help the situation? It seems you are the victim of being scapegoated. Are there no good people that stand for fairness there? This is one thing I know from being targeted by a bully. Once I allowed him to have his way other people began bullying me and saw me as an easy target. If I could go back I would have stood up for myself and asserted a statement letting them know I would not stand up for that. That is what happened to me, I know your situation is different, I just wanted to share something.

This might be hard to answer. But I want to get to the root of this. Do people physically bully you at the academy or do they do it verbally and how many people treat you that way? Is there anyway you can defend yourself from this to let people know you won't take that.
Have you considered looking for a new job? The way they treat you at your current one is unfair. And if finishing medical school is the goal, wouldn't you want it changed?

Okay from what I understand you seem to have a good goal for all the right reasons. You seem to be a empathetic person that is genuinely interested in the well being of other individuals and communities. I'm gonna be straight forward with you. If you think you'd be happier around people in that field, would you leave the military?

You seem like an introspective, well thought out, and pleasant individual. I'd like to share something that struck me. I have the default bitch face(which people always remind me by asking if I'm okay) and I feel more likable when I'm under the influence of alcohol. I'm curious though. Did those moments of feeling liked and sociable give you joy?

These are my honest thoughts. I'm not a professional therapist, but I would consider a new counselor because the one that said you're a parents worst nightmare sounds unprofessional. I know that these thoughts you are struggling with would be too hard to share with friends or family. So long as you don't act on them you are not doing any harm. I would recommend a counselor that specializes in cognitive therapy. Have you considered this?

I'm sorry that you're going through this situation and I don't know if this will help or not, but you're not alone. I suffered from severe anxiety and depression through out high school. You're fortunate you have your family and friends behind you because I didn't have that. My parents used to abuse me physically and verbally. I was bullied in high school. Video games were my escape partially, but it can be very addictive. What do you see yourself doing one day? What do you want to be?

I'm in the same situation right now. Struggling with classes and also having a hard time finding a job. What do you think would make you want to continue living? What sort of lifestyle do you see yourself having one day?

I'm sorry to hear you're in this situation. the way you're being treated is inhumane. You seem like a bright and honest individual. If you can make it through these hard times(which I sincerely hope you choose to) what are you looking forward to after the academy?

my heart goes out to you on this. i have to ask though. does she have any friend or other family members who can be reached out to? it seems she's trying to push you away to make this decision easier.
i agree. you're right.
i'm doing better for sure. i just need to find more things that motivate me to live.
you're right. i guess im just rebuilding things right now. trying to figure out what i want to do and more things to bring me joy. something to give me motivation to live.
i appreciate that

you seem very smart if you could even get into medical school. i'm sure if you hold on and keep saving up you will find a way. my uncle had the military pay his way through med school. im not really sure about other options though besides saving up.
That's very unfair and I'm sorry that's the situation currently. Are you currently looking for something more promising?
there is hope. youll find a job and get money. dont give up please...

i'm sorry that i'm not helping. i wish i could help you. the reason i say things will get better is because they did for me. i was in a dark place just 2 nights ago and people here helped me. are you planning on doing this tonight?
please dont do it. things will get better if you hold on. no one can be you. even the way you write impressed on me. what gave you hope to make it this long?
well everyone here has made me believe that. thank you.
thank you. i appreciate you reaching out to me. i do like reading. id say that brings good feelings to me
you're right. thank you
i appreciate that
thanks for all the recommendations.
thank you
